title: General Training Writing — Letter 5
description: Task 1 letter, 5 of 29. Write at least 150 words.

sections.title: Writing — Task 1 (letter)
sections.instructions: Write the letter in the box below. It is not auto-scored.

questions.prompt:
You have seen an advertisement in an English newspaper for a job working in the City Museum shop during the holidays. You decide to apply for the job.
Write a letter to the director of the Museum. In your letter,
introduce yourself
explain what experience and special skills you have
explain why you are interested in the job
